name: pulsechain-grid-bot
description: PulseChain PulseX V2 grid bot: server-side engine, auto-signing live mode, paper mode

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && vite build && esbuild src/server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --packages=external --outfile=dist/server/index.js
